title: feat(driver-sql,objectql)!: a tenant-scoped read no longer answers a row with no organization (18.x step 7, part 7a-1)
body:
Part of #24583 (18.x step 7, part 7a-1: the driver's NULL-organization arm). The card stays open for the other step-7 parts (7b-1, 7b-2, 7b-3).

Clause-②: no (narrowing)

**Landing order.** This branch started from `main` merged with `claude/issue-24581-ceremony-open` (#24681, steps 5+6), because it retires readers that only certification makes dead. #24681 has since merged (`c6f775cbd`), and this branch has merged `main` again (`307ce4c4b`). The diff against `main` is this part alone: 19 files, +332 / −241, no governed path (`check-governed-merges --branch`: 0 of 19 on the register, under the 3,000-line line).

## What changes

- **`SqlDriver.applyTenantScope`** (`packages/drivers/driver-sql/src/sql-driver.ts`). Both `orWhereNull` arms are gone. A tenant scope compiles to `organization_id = :tenant`, or `organization_id IN (…)` under `group`. A row with no organization is no tenant's (ADR-0131 D1, D14). With no tenant on the call, or no tenant column, the read stays unscoped, as before. The Turso remote face compiles the same chokepoint, so it follows by construction; only its two docblocks changed.
- **`readBackInsertedRows`** (same file). The docblock is restated. One consequence of the retired arm is handled in code: the rows' own tenant union scopes the read-back only when *every* written row carries a tenant. A batch with no tenant on the call that mixes stamped and unstamped rows would otherwise miss its own unstamped row after it landed, and the refusal would fire after the write. The ids are this call's own primary keys, so the read cannot reach a row this call did not write.
- **`LifecycleService` global retention / archive pass** (`packages/objectql/src/lifecycle/lifecycle-service.ts`). On an `organization_id` partition the `{ [column]: null }` disjunct is gone and the bare `$nin` stays. ⚠️ **The disjunct is kept on the attribution partition** (`sys_audit_log.tenant_id`, ADR-0131 D7). There, NULL is a live, deployment-level value and not a pre-ceremony one: on the ceremonied 18.0 fixture, `sys_audit_log.tenant_id` holds 14 NULL rows of 172. `tenantWindowsFor` makes the decision once, as `TenantPartition.nullIsLive`, so the passes name no column of their own (the federated-reader ledger's existing `tenantWindowsFor` row stays true).
- **objectql engine docblocks** that named the driver's `OR … IS NULL` (`buildDriverOptions`'s federated note, the reference-probe and master-header notes).
- **Pins.** Tests that asserted the retired reach now assert the new rule. Fixtures whose NULL row was incidental are re-stamped. Where an organization-less row *is* the probe, it stays and is now asserted unreached (the driver tenant-scope and read-door suites, the Turso local/remote parity suite, plugin-sharing's rule-sweep / record-share / share-link stamps, service-storage's upload-door writes).

## Premise check: is every retired reader dead?

| Population | Reading |
|---|---|
| Fresh `single` install (`pnpm dev:crm -- --fresh`), after seeded-admin sign-in and a REST create | 35 tables carry `organization_id`; **0** NULL rows. The session carries an active organization. |
| Certified database (`ceremoniedFixture` over the 18.0 fixture) | 66 tables carry `organization_id`; **0** NULL rows. `sys_audit_log.tenant_id`: 14 / 172 NULL (the kept attribution arm). |
| Walled boot (`isolated` `os serve`, real `@objectstack/organizations`) | 30 tables; **0** NULL rows. |
| `single` posture reads | The driver carries no tenant scope at all (ADR-0131 D8), so the arm was never reached there. |
| Composition with no organization object (`no-organization-object`) | It still writes NULL rows, but nothing there carries a tenant to the driver. Session, guest and system writes resolve none, so `applyTenantScope` exits before the arm. Shipped compositions: `examples/embed-objectql` (memory driver, which refuses tenant scope); every `os serve` composition with `Auth` registers `sys_organization` (plugin-auth). |

## Proof (head `2ee8e8d87`, after the last `main` merge)

- **R1.** `pnpm dev:crm -- --fresh -p <random>` from a full build: health 200, seeded-admin sign-in 200, `crm_account` create 201, list 200, 0 error lines.
- **R2 + R3.** `upgrade-18x-harness.dogfood.test.ts` + `organization-ownership-boot-refusal-order.dogfood.test.ts`: 12 / 12.
- **R4.** The built CLI (`bin/run-dev.js serve`), `OS_TENANCY_POSTURE=isolated` with the walled prerequisites, on a throwaway app that declares the real `@objectstack/organizations`. It reached the banner, `Tenancy: isolated`, `Organizations` mounted, discovery 200, health 200, 0 refusals; the database it created holds 0 NULL `organization_id` rows in 30 tables. Step 4's seven walled e2e cases (`OS_TEST_TIERS=nightly`): 7 / 7.
- **Full suites, on the final head after a full build.** driver-sql: 223 files, 3682 passed. objectql: 451 files, 8495 passed. driver-turso: 92 files, 2430 passed. plugin-sharing: 51 files, 1193 passed. `typecheck` exit 0 for objectql, driver-sql and driver-turso. Downstream: the 92 test files in 13 packages that reach an organization-less row through the real SQL driver, all green (1636 tests). The 5 among them that pinned the retired reach are rewritten here.
- **Ablation** (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` at `9987cf807`, the same driver code as the final head; mutation landed and restored to `blob == HEAD`, `git diff HEAD` empty). Re-adding `orWhereNull` on the equality arm turns 4 pins red in `sql-driver-tenant-scope.test.ts`. Reverting the read-back guard turns the new mixed-batch pin red on the read-back face.
- **Gates.** `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` on the final head: 78 commands. Each was run with its exit code captured before any pipe, and all 78 exited 0. `--ran` reconciliation: 78 derived, 78 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a derived zero: every line carries its exit code).

## Acceptance notes

- The claim's file list named driver-sql, the Turso parity tests, objectql's lifecycle and engine docblocks, and "the tenant-scope tests". Measured, those tests also live in plugin-sharing (3 files), service-storage (1 file) and driver-sql's #21227 read-back suite (1 new case). Their pins asserted the retired reach and are rewritten here. The one code line beyond the claim's wording is `readBackInsertedRows`'s scope guard (the claim named its docblock); it is the read-back consequence of the retired arm, and it is in the same function. `packages/drivers/driver-turso/src/{turso-driver,remote-transport}.ts` changed in docblocks only.
- `engine.ts`'s dangling-reference audit docblock ("a NULL-organization row … probes unscoped") is unchanged. It describes that audit's own code, which this part does not touch.
- `packages/runtime/src/domains/packages.ts` still says env-wide `sys_metadata` reads are `organization_id IS NULL`. `sys_metadata` has carried no organization column since `18.sys-metadata-organization-column-retired` (`systemFields: { tenant: false }`), so the driver arm never applied there. Text drift, left for its owner.
- service-storage's driver-leg `legacy` row was seeded with `tenantId: 'org_A'`, so `injectTenantOnInsert` stamped it and the old "stays reachable" pin was vacuous. It is now seeded with no tenant and asserted unreached.
- Not touched: the schema differ, index keys and COALESCE (7b-1 / 7b-2), `__global__` (7b-3), `docs/adr/**`.
